scope: Authoritative source tracing for Hero header/basic display semantics with explicit separation of confirmed semantics from source data gaps.

canonicalIdentity.reuseRule: Do not rebuild playable-Hero identity in Stage 5-5-2.

rarity.starMeaning: initial/current base star count; not the rarity label
rarity.coverage: 267/267 canonical Heroes resolve to a validated Rank value.
rarity.rule: Use Rank for rarity display. Use Star only for star count. ExchangedFragmentCount remains rejected because it is duplicate-acquisition fragment quantity, not the rarity enum.

factions.coverage: 267/267 canonical Heroes have at least one faction; zero SuperHero-not-member mismatches.
factions.rule: Use RelatedHeros_ID for membership. SuperHero_ID is faction-buff ownership and must not be used as membership.

cv.rule: Use CVName as the authoritative source field. For Hero IDs 99235, 99236 and 99276, source value ■■■■ is confirmed to mean no voice actor, not masked or unresolved actor data. Preserve all other source spellings as-is.

localization.scope: Chinese-localized CVName spellings -> Korean voice-actor display names
localization.rule: Do not auto-transliterate or rewrite actor names in ConfigData-derived artifacts. User will localize display names later.

origin.canonicalShape: 267/267 canonical Heroes contain exactly one production ID
origin.meaning: source/origin work; equivalent to Bilibili Wiki 出典
origin.coverage: 267/267 Heroes resolved; observed production IDs 1-32 exactly match dictionary IDs 1-32; no missing, unknown or unused IDs.
origin.rule: Resolve the single HeroBelongProduction ID through the validated origin dictionary. Preserve originLabelCn as source-display text; Korean work-title localization may be layered separately without changing productionId semantics.

artwork.coverage: 267/267 canonical Heroes have non-empty HeroPainting values and all 267 values are distinct.

fieldRoles.HeroPainting: large static Hero painting/prefab for Hero-detail display
fieldRoles.SpineBackground: optional special Spine background; not a universal Hero-detail background source

artwork.rule: Use HeroPainting for the base Hero-detail main illustration. Do not substitute CardHeadImage/head icons or Spine resources for the static header painting.

skins.coverage: 540/540 canonical skin references resolve uniquely with no ownership mismatch.

artwork.coverage: 540/540 canonical skins resolve to non-empty Image and SpineAssetPath.
artwork.rule: Use Image for the static skin illustration/resource image and SpineAssetPath for the animated skin model. Do not join skin resource IDs to ConfigDataCharImageInfo.

ordering.rule: Preserve Skins_ID array order exactly. Do not re-sort by skin ID, Score, FixedStoreItemInfo.UISort or acquisition category.
ordering.reason: Skins_ID[] is the only explicit per-Hero skin membership sequence; ID and Score sorting do not reproduce all source sequences.

acquisition.missingRule: Missing GetPathType is not one acquisition category. Keep it null/UNENCODED. Exact acquisition history for those skins requires a supplemental verified dictionary rather than inference.
acquisition.counterexample: Matthew skin 执事美酒 has no GetPathType and is an event reward, proving that missing values cannot be collapsed into a single store/event label.

skins.scoreRule: Do not use ConfigDataHeroSkinInfo.Score as display order. It correlates with skin category/value but is not a universal per-Hero ordering field.

nonSynthesisPolicy: Confirmed source joins and enum meanings may be used directly. Missing GetPathType stays null until a separately verified acquisition dictionary exists; do not invent acquisition routes.
deferredTasks: Localize ConfigDataCharImageInfo.CVName source spellings into Korean voice-actor display names without changing the confirmed CV source join.
Optionally localize originLabelCn work titles into Korean display titles without changing the confirmed HeroBelongProduction productionId dictionary.
If exact acquisition text is required for all skins, build a supplemental verified acquisition dictionary for the 176 canonical skins whose GetPathType is omitted.
nextGate: Stage 5-5-2 semantic interpretation is complete. Continue integration while treating 176 missing GetPathType values as an explicit source-data gap, not an unresolved enum meaning.
